preconditions.description: The number of tournaments n must be between 1 and 50,000.
The number of kinds of sport k must be between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= sij <= 10**9 for i in range(n) for j in range(k))
preconditions.description: Each sportsman's power in each kind of sport must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(1) if n == 1 else True
postconditions.description: For the first tournament, the output must be 1 as there is only one sportsman.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: The output must contain valid integers representing the number of possible winners for each tournament.
The output must contain exactly n integers, one for each tournament.
